action: Introduce drought-tolerant legume cover crops during non-cropping periods.
why_it_works: Cover crops replace bare soil periods with continuous root activity, increasing organic carbon inputs and microbial biomes.
environmental_mechanism: Legume root exudates stimulate nitrogen fixation and mycorrhizal networks, rebuilding aggregate structure and moisture retention.
trade_offs: Requires careful termination timing to prevent soil water depletion before cash crop planting.
monitoring: Track volumetric soil moisture at 0-15 cm depth during dry transitions

action: Establish perennial native flowering strips along crop field borders.
why_it_works: Field margins provide floral resources and undisturbed nesting sites for native pollinators and pest predators.
environmental_mechanism: Diversifies micro-habitats and breaks up landscape monoculture fragmentation, raising wild pollinator density.
time_horizon: Short: 1 season (pollinator visits); Medium: 2-4 years (established habitat)
trade_offs: Takes a small percentage of marginal land out of primary crop production.
monitoring: Perform seasonal wild pollinator visual transect counts during bloom periods.
